name: Ryuzouin Tessen
source:
Tessen is a senior at Gaisenji High School in Meguro, where he is captain of the sojutsu team. He comes from the house known for "Ryuzoin the Yin" and "Hozoin the Yang," two family ancestors famous for their style of spear fighting.

[From [url=http://www.nisamerica.com/games/tokyotwilightghosthunters/characters/]official website[/url]]
